name: 賴冠廷
objective: The goal of this course is to give students a broad overview of state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms, and teach students how to develop deep learning applications by hands-on coding examples. Most examples taught in this class are based on the TensorFlow framework. We will cover many different fields including image classification, object detection, natural language processing, reinforcement learning and generative adversarial networks.
schedule:
Course website: http://www.aiotlab.org/teaching/dl_app.html

1. Introduction to Deep Learning
2. Applied Math (Linear Algebra, Probability, Calculus)
3. Machine Learning Basics
4. TensorFlow & Keras
5. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
6. Advanced Keras API & PyTorch
7. Natural Language Processing (NLP), Word Embedding, Self-supervised Learning
8. Midterm exam
9. Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) & Long Short-term Memory (LSTM)
10. Attention is all you need! Attention and Transformer
11. Large Language Models (LLMs), ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek
12. Agentic AI: OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and more
13. Object Detection and Segmentation
14. Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) and Diffusion models
15. Deep Reinforcement Learning and Stable Baseline
16. Graph Convolution Networks (GCNs)
17. Group Study and Presentation
18. Final exam
scorePolicy: Homework (30%), Midterm (20%), Final Exam (20%), Group Study (10%), Quizzes (15%) and attendance (5%)

延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.

課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
● 使用生成式 AI 進行課堂即時互動（Use generative AI for real-time classroom interaction）
● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
